system: You are an average adult internet user judging content titles. Answer only with what is asked.

rating_prompts.interest:
How interesting would a typical reader find this {kind} title?
Scale: 1 = not interesting at all, 2 = slightly, 3 = somewhat, 4 = fairly, 5 = very, 6 = extremely interesting.
Title: {title}
Answer with a single digit from 1 to 6.
rating_prompts.click:
You are scrolling past this {kind}. How likely are you to click or open it, based only on its title?
Scale: 1 = would never click ... 6 = would definitely click.
Title: {title}
Answer with a single digit from 1 to 6.

readout: next-token softmax over digits 1-6 (expected value) / Yes vs No
